reason: The price is not the problem, and the cash-drawer check and seeing who is in which chair from outside would really help me with 8 staff. But my whole salon runs on WhatsApp on one phone, and I will not move billing onto an app from people I don't know when nothing here says who picks up the phone if it stops working.
objection: On a busy Sunday with every chair full, if billing hangs or a stylist's phone stops logging in, who will help me? If there is no one, my staff go back to the notebook and UPI screenshots, and I have paid ₹10,000 for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A named support person in Bhubaneswar who answers the phone on Sundays, plus one month free so I can run it next to my current way and see that my staff actually use it.
